text: LangGraph gives excellent control over agent flows. Explicit state and conditional edges make the behaviour easy to debug and very reliable.
Muy potente y flexible para orquestar agentes. La curva de aprendizaje es algo dificil al principio, pero la documentacion ayuda.
Persistence, human-in-the-loop and streaming are great out of the box. I recommend it for production workloads.
The API is verbose and confusing for simple cases. For a quick prototype it feels complex.
Estable y robusto; el estado tipado evita muchos errores. Buen soporte para depurar cada nodo.
Best choice when you need deterministic routing between agents. Fast to iterate once you know the concepts.
CrewAI is easy and intuitive: roles and tasks map naturally to a team. Great for quick prototypes.
Facil de empezar, pero el control fino del flujo es limitado y a veces resulta dificil depurar.
Agents sometimes loop and the behaviour is hard to predict. Not reliable enough for my production use case.
Muy bueno para equipos de agentes con roles claros. La comunidad es activa y los ejemplos son utiles.
Good idea, but the abstraction hides too much and debugging is slow.
AutoGen shines for conversational multi-agent patterns. Flexible and powerful, with a strong research community.
La configuracion es compleja y la API cambio mucho entre versiones; resulto confuso y fragil.
Great for experiments but the conversations are expensive and hard to control. Production readiness is lacking.
Excelente para prototipar conversaciones entre agentes; muy flexible y con buenos ejemplos.
